title: qgb gate report (curated, strict)
description: Schema for the curated gate.json under evidence/<REQ>/latest/. Strict (additionalProperties false) at every level to keep committed evidence clean. Note (Phase 2 Step 2.4): a mode=check rehearsal gate also validates against this schema, so schema validity alone does not prove a document is an official gate — consumers must treat the ABSENCE of 'mode' as the mark of an official run gate. qgb itself never writes a check gate into the curated tree.

mode.description: Phase 2 Step 2.4: present (value 'check') only on gates produced by 'qgb check' — a rehearsal that never updates curated evidence and is not an official gate. Official 'qgb run' gates omit this field entirely (absence = official). When mode=check, paths.curated_latest_dir must be absent (see allOf) so machine consumers cannot mistake the rehearsal for a curated update.

timestamp_utc.description: Compact UTC timestamp (wall-clock truth, seconds precision): YYYY-MM-DDTHHMMSSZ. Same instant as timestamp_rfc3339. The trailing path segment of paths.run_dir is <timestamp_utc>-<run_id>, not timestamp alone, so two runs inside the same wall-clock second remain distinguishable without falsifying the timestamp.

run_id.description: Per-second monotonic counter that disambiguates run directories when timestamp_utc collides. Format: 'r' followed by 4 lowercase hex digits ('r0001' to 'rffff'), assigned at run_dir reservation time and embedded in paths.run_dir. Has no relationship to timestamp meaning; timestamp_utc stays honest. r0000 is reserved (the runner starts counting from r0001) so an externally produced gate.json cannot claim a run_id the implementation can never generate.

failed_stage.description: Empty string when status=ALLOW; first failed stage id when status=DENY.

scope.description: Step 6+7 統合レビュー RA2: project-local P11 framing (judgement scope). 'meaning' is kept verbatim per F-016; 'scope' carries the P11 annotation as a separate field so exact-match consumers of meaning are not broken.

run_dir.description: Volatile run directory. Trailing segment shape: <timestamp_utc>-<run_id> where timestamp_utc matches the field of the same name (YYYY-MM-DDTHHMMSSZ) and run_id matches r[0-9a-f]{4} excluding r0000. Phase 2 Step 2.4: curated_latest_dir is conditionally required — present iff the gate is an official run gate (mode absent); a check rehearsal gate (mode=check) must omit it (see allOf).

result.description: Step 7: 'waived' indicates the stage was explicitly waived by REQ meta and excluded from judgement. An ALLOW gate is allowed to contain waived stages alongside passed ones, but every non-waived stage must be passed.

reason.description: Step 3.1c: machine-readable reason for a non-passing command stage. Optional — present only when qgb.core.command had to terminate the process tree (timeout or 16 MiB per-stream execution cap). Absent for natural exits regardless of exit_code. Enum values are part of the gate.json contract; new codes require a schema migration.

runner_warning.description: Step 3.1b-3 / 3.1c: free-text record of degraded kill paths (e.g. Windows Job Object setup failed → grandchildren may leak). Optional — when present, indicates the gate's audit trail has a known weakness on this stage that no machine could compensate for. Search for non-null runner_warning in basis audits to find compromised stages.

synthetic.description: Step 6+7 統合レビュー RA1: true when the evidence builder synthesised this entry because the runner produced no result for the adopted stage. Distinguishes runner-integrity gaps from normal stage failures.

synthetic_reason.description: Step 6+7 統合レビュー RA1: required when synthetic=true; identifies why the entry was synthesised.

allOf.description: Official run gate (mode absent): paths.curated_latest_dir is required — qgb run always updates curated evidence (Phase 1 invariant, byte-compatible with pre-mode gates).

Check rehearsal gate (mode=check, Phase 2 Step 2.4): paths.curated_latest_dir must be ABSENT — qgb check never updates curated evidence, and pointing at a curated dir that was not updated would mislead machine consumers.

ALLOW: failed_stage must be empty, decision.result must be ALLOW, every non-waived stage must have result=passed, and at least one passed stage must exist (Step 7: ALLOW with all stages waived is forbidden).

DENY: decision.result must be DENY. Either a stage actually failed (failed_stage non-empty, at least one stage.result=failed) OR every adopted stage is waived (failed_stage empty, no stages.result=failed) — the latter is Step 7's 'no judgement material' branch.

oneOf.description: All-waived DENY (Step 7): no judgement material. failed_stage is empty and no stage has result=failed.
